## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No production host or real credentials were used for testing.
- [ ] Privileged/system-mutating behavior is identified and tested in a disposable environment.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private keys, or sensitive host data are included.
- [ ] Existing behavior and compatibility boundaries are documented.
- [ ] Claims are limited to evidence actually captured.
